description: The one fixed throwaway platform tenant uat-tmp-fixture (PM 22:4x): looked up first; created through POST /api/v1/tenants only when absent and only when the run was started with --allow-create; then the step waits for it to be active and reactivates it when a process left it deactivated. Never purged (QA answers 404 to a purge of a uat-tmp tenant), never residue (the platform residue rule names it). While it does not exist (and the run has no --allow-create) fixture_id stays unset: every step of a process that says requires fixture_id is then SKIPPED with that reason, the log row names it.
leaves: The tenant uat-tmp-fixture stays on QA, active, by design. After the provisioner window the per-run create and purge replaces it (PM 22:4x, item 2).

steps.says: Look for the fixture tenant by its fixed slug (404 is an answer, not a failure).
Create it only when absent (the run must be started with --allow-create; without the flag the step is skipped with that reason).
Wait until the tenant exists (the registration process creates it in the background).
Known state: active. Reactivating an active tenant is a no-op that answers 200.

cleanup.says: The fixture is NOT removed (QA cannot purge it and it is reused): after a run that created it, this only confirms it is there.
